function MaxProductPartition(n: integer): integer;
begin
  if n = 2 then
    Result := 1
  else if n <= 4 then
    Result := n
  else if n mod 3 = 0 then
    Result := Round(Power(3, n div 3))
  else if n mod 3 = 1 then
    Result := 4 * Round(Power(3, (n - 4) div 3))
  else
    Result := 2 * Round(Power(3, (n - 2) div 3));
end;
